title: MCP Server
description: A registration for a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. MCP server entities are referenced by name from agent manifest tool resources (type 'mcp-server-entity') and resolved into MCP tools at runtime. Storing servers as entities lets different machines and users register different servers (for example, machine-specific stdio commands) under the same logical name.

serverName.description: The logical name of the MCP server (e.g., 'github'). Tool resources reference this name to resolve the server.

serverDescription.description: Human-readable description of the MCP server and the tools it provides.

description.description: Optional description used when the server is surfaced as a tool.

connection.description: MCP server connection. Discriminated by 'kind'. Supported kinds: Anonymous, key, oauth.

endpoint.description: http(s):// MCP URL, or stdio://?command=<exe>&arg=<a>&cwd=<dir> for a local process.
http(s):// MCP URL (stdio:// with an apiKey is rejected at runtime).

apiKey.description: Bearer token. Supports ${ENV_VAR} and ${SECRET:Name}. Special-case ${GITHUB_TOKEN} falls back to gh auth token.

endpoint.description: http(s):// MCP resource endpoint. OAuth metadata is discovered from it (RFC 9728/8414).

clientId.description: Optional. Omit to use dynamic client registration (RFC 7591). Supports ${ENV_VAR}/${SECRET:Name}.

clientSecret.description: Optional. Omit for a public client (PKCE). Supports ${SECRET:Name}.

tokenUrl.description: Optional explicit token endpoint; normally discovered automatically.

approvalMode.description: Tool-call approval policy for this server. Mirrors the agent tool approvalMode (kinds: 'always', 'never', 'specify').

alwaysRequireApprovalTools.description: When kind is 'specify', the tool names that always require approval.

neverRequireApprovalTools.description: When kind is 'specify', the tool names that never require approval.

allowedTools.description: Optional allow-list of tool names exposed by the server. When omitted, all tools are available.
